subject.title: feat(huggingface): add text-to-image generation via hf-inference Inference Providers route

question: Should maintainers consolidate Hugging Face image-generation work on the fuller related branch, or sponsor this partial branch as the replacement path?
rationale: Both branches target the same new bundled provider capability, but this one is partial while the fuller branch is currently conflicting and still has merge-risk/proof blockers; automation should not choose the canonical landing branch without maintainer intent.

options.title: Consolidate on the fuller related branch
options.body: Keep this branch blocked and continue the feature on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72129 after it is rebased, repaired, and proven.

options.title: Sponsor this branch as replacement
options.body: Ask this contributor to port the missing entrypoint, manifest, docs, default-model, transport, bounded-response, and live-proof work here before review continues.

options.title: Decline bundled provider expansion
options.body: Close both bundled-provider attempts and redirect the capability to an external plugin path if maintainers do not want Hugging Face image generation in core.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the fuller related branch
recommendation.body: Keep this branch blocked and continue the feature on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/72129 after it is rebased, repaired, and proven.

likelyOwner.reason: The related PR history cites prior maintainer direction to narrow the broader Hugging Face extras work into the existing plugin, and steipete merged/reviewed the original provider boundary.
